text: TOMORROW: unit online. sector 7 sanitation scheduled.
INTERCEPT: ad-network node KIOSK routing to your position.
INTERCEPT: SWEEPER-9 dispatched. all units clear the grid.
your tag reads UNIT-7. nobody has called it in years.
scrap on the floor is credit. pick it up, the grid pays for waste.
a skitter chews a cable. the district lights flicker.
the pingers are tracing you. keep moving.
someone left a maintenance note: DO NOT FEED THE BRUTES.
ALERT: sector 7 declares a cleanup surge. brace.
firewalls ahead. the grid is hiding something behind them.
ALERT: second surge inbound from the loading docks.
the kiosk is silent. all its screens show your face.
ALERT: skitter swarm in spiral formation. dodge in, not out.
your parts hum. you are not the model that woke up.
ALERT: final surge. the grid spends everything it has.
the streets thin out. something larger is coming.
